tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// rtsa ba'i bla ma la thun mong ma yin pa'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa bzhugs// ༄༅// phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ chos kyi rje chos kyi rgyal po chos kyi dbang phyug chos dam pa'i 'byor pa thams cad kyis phun sum tshogs shing*/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i dpal dam par gyur pa bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mo dri ma med pa la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gi sngon gyi las las gyur pa dang*/ gnas skabs kyi rkyen las gyur pa dang*/ mi dang mi ma yin pa dang*/ 'byung ba'i gnod pa dang*/ nye bar 'tshe ba dang*/ nad dang skal ba ngan pa dang*/ phyi dang nang gi bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ tshe dang*/ dpal dang*/ 'byor pa dang*/ dge legs dang*/ dbang phyug phun sum tshogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad dang*/ mtshan ma'i rnam par g.yeng ba la sogs pa srid par 'khor bar 'gyur ba'i rnam par rtog pa dang*/ gzhan gyi don la skyo ba dang*/ bdag nyid zhi bar 'dun pa la sogs pa mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ba'i rnam par rtog pa gang lags pa thams cad mi 'byung bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gi sems las su rung ba dang*/ bag yod pa dang*/ dran pa dang shes bzhin yang dag pa dang ldan par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gi tshul khrims kyi phung po dang*/ dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs rnam par dag cing*/ sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang*/ ltung ba dang*/ nyes pa'i dri mas mi gos par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dad pa dang*/ snying rje dang*/ shes rab phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan zhing*/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis zung du chud nas/ lung dang mngon par rtogs pas bsdus pa'i chos kyi snang ba dam pa dang*/

rtogs pa dge ba rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gang gi tshe bdag nyid 'chi ba'i dus byed par 'gyur ba de'i tshe/ tshe 'di dang 'jig rten 'di la mngon par zhen pa dang bral zhing*/ lus dang sems la zug rngu dang sdug bsngal ba cung zad tsam yang mi 'byung bar dga' ba dang*/ spro ba dang*/ yid gsal ba mchog dang ldan zhing*/ ting nge 'dzin dam pa rgyud la skyes nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs yang dag par mthong zhing*/ de dag gi rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pas bsu ste/ bar do'i 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral zhing*/ bdud dang gshin rje'i spyod yul las shin tu 'das nas rig pa 'dzin pa dang*/ mkha' la spyod pa la sogs pa'i go 'phang mchog tu skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ skye ba dang srid pa thams cad du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rgud pa thams cad dang bral zhing*/ srid pa dang zhi ba'i 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa thob ste/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung rab rgya mtsho'i tshogs yang dag par bzung ste chos kyi phongs pa'i sems can thams cad la chos kyi sbyin pa rgya chen po btang zhing*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa dang*/ sems can rnams yongs su smin par byas nas/ dngos po thams cad kyis bla ma dam pa mnyes par byas te/ sa dang lam thams cad bde blag tu bgrod nas/ sku bzhi ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang myur du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa la thun mong ma yin pa'i sgo nas gsol ba gdab pa'i tshig 'di ni/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes bya ba la/ de nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan zhing*/ bsod snyoms dang*/ stan gcig pa dang*/ phyis mi len pa'i brtul zhugs la legs par gnas pa/

dge slong gnas brtan byang chub bzang po zhes bya bas gsol ba btab nas me mo yos bu'i lo smin drug gi zla ba'i yar gyi ngo'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin par gnam gyi sa'i cha la sbyar ba'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
